title: The stage backfill finishes quickly on long delta chains and master status counts the rows left down to zero
description: On a running test install seeded with 50 items of 800-row delta chains on 180 KB documents, the loop's stage backfill stores each row's stage from its base's stage and the row's own stage edits, every batch under 5 seconds and all in under 5 minutes; master status shows the rows left falling to zero and names no backfill statement over 5 seconds.

steps.name: master status shows the backfill's rows left reach zero and no backfill statement over 5 s
